motions.motion: Councilmember Clark moved to approve the Consent Agenda, moving item 9.A. WDG Website Services Change Order #1 to the Scheduled Items for further discussion. Councilmember Burnham seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Consent agenda approved, website item pulled out
motions.summary: The council approved its consent agenda after moving the WDG website change order off it for separate discussion.
motions.impact: A batch of pre-cleared items cleared in one vote, with one held back for debate. This is meeting mechanics only.

motions.item_title: Approve the WDG Website Services Change Order #1 with the following change: Everything after th…
motions.motion: Councilmember Burnham moved to approve the WDG Website Services Change Order #1 with the following change: Everything after the first sentence in Section 2 will be removed and replaced with, “While this estimate is prepared with precision and with the details provided to WDG during the estimation, WDG has the right to account for unknown variables that may affect the final budget, timeline, or fee structure.” Councilmember Clark seconded the motion. The recording of the discussion regarding the motion can be found online here at 01:51:40.
motions.headline: City website contract change order approved
motions.summary: The council approved a change order to its website contract with WDG, rewriting the cost language so the vendor can adjust for unforeseen variables.
motions.impact: Work continues on the city's website. The rewritten clause is a matter between the city and its vendor, and you will not notice it.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Section 17.55.120 Tables, Regarding Parking Requirements for Hotel, Motel, and Breakfast Uses
motions.motion: Councilmember Burnham moved to approve an Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Section 17.55.120 Tables, Regarding Parking Requirements for Hotel, Motel, and Breakfast Uses. Councilmember Wright seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Fewer parking spaces required for hotels
motions.summary: The council changed the city code's parking rules for hotels, motels and bed-and-breakfast businesses, altering how many spaces those buildings must provide.
motions.impact: This lands on anyone planning or building lodging in Eagle Mountain. If you are not putting up a hotel, nothing in your day changes.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending Eagle Mountain Municipal Code to Enact Chapter 17.69 Second Kitchens or Kitchenettes
motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved to approve An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending Eagle Mountain Municipal Code to Enact Chapter 17.69 Second Kitchens or Kitchenettes. Councilmember Gray seconded the motion.
motions.headline: New rules for second kitchens in homes
motions.summary: The city added a new section to its code, Chapter 17.69, setting rules for second kitchens and kitchenettes in homes.
motions.impact: If you have or are planning a second kitchen in your house, it is now regulated by the city. The motion itself doesn't spell out the requirements, so check with the planning department before building one.
